answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 47723 Country: India Title: Islamic names for girls Question: I have a daughter named Munazzah Asif and recently blessed with another daughter whose name I want to keep with the letter M and which is also similar to Munazzah. So please suggest few modern Islamic names with meanings starting with the letter M? Answer ID: 47723 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1405/L-471/TL=11/1434) You should keep the name Munirah for your second daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
